subject: cone snail
title: A Snail Puts Fish to Sleep With Insulin, Then Swallows Them Whole

scenes.text: Fish swim straight into a snail's mouth. It drugs them with insulin first.
The geography cone snail releases a cloud of chemicals into the water. Inside the mix are molecules that act like insulin.
Insulin drops blood sugar. Other molecules stop the fish from raising it back up.
The fish grow drowsy and float to a stop, and the snail opens a net-like mouth around it.
Then a harpoon fires venom into it. The snail eats the fish whole.
The same snail can kill people. Scientists first found the insulin weapon in 2015.

description:
The geography cone snail hunts fish by releasing a cloud of chemicals that includes insulin-like molecules, crashing the fish's blood sugar so it drifts to a stop.
Then the snail engulfs it with a net-like mouth and finishes it with a venom harpoon. The same species can kill people.
Would you have guessed a snail could do this?
